warnings: House title block: 'แบบบ้านยิ้มเพื่อประชาชน' (Smile Home project), ตามนโยบาย ม.ร.ว.สุขุมพันธุ์ บริพัตร ผู้ว่าราชการกรุงเทพมหานคร, โดยสำนักการโยธา กรุงเทพมหานคร, แบบได้รับความอนุเคราะห์จากบริษัท แลนดี้ โฮม (ประเทศไทย) จำกัด — design name 'แสงดาว' printed on the page01 series-brochure cover (a generic multi-design cover shared across this BMA 'Smile Home' series; house-specific confirmation is the 'TYPE S' construction-notes page and the 8.20x8.00m 2-story hip-roof plan unique to this file set). Same overall series as houses already in the dataset (e.g. 28บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_12 '(024) ธรรมรักษา'), but this house has its own distinct grid (8.20x8.00m here vs 6.00x9.10m for house 12) and its own steel-roof design — not a duplicate.

No sheet_code (no 'S-01' style stamp) and no printed page/sheet number were found anywhere in this drawing set's structural sheets (checked bottom margins and title blocks at 2x zoom on หน้า14 and หน้า20) — unlike some other houses in this batch. sheet_code is recorded as null throughout this house, and doc_page is set equal to the PNG file's own page-sequence number (its filename '_หน้าNN') as the best available proxy for position in the document, since no independent printed numbering exists to cross-check against.

x_lines (1-2-3-4: 3.00/2.20/3.00=8.20) and y_lines (A-B-C-D: 3.00/3.00/2.00=8.00) are printed identically and repeatedly on the architectural floor plans (หน้า03, หน้า04) and on the structural plans หน้า14 (footing), หน้า15 (floor-1 beams) and หน้า16 (floor-2 beams) — cross-checked, fully consistent, no discrepancy. dimension_chains cite หน้า14 as the representative source rather than repeating the identical chain. ⚠️ AMENDED 2026-08-24: หน้า17 (roof framing) is the ONE exception and must not be counted in that list — its own y margin chain totals 6.00 and stops at row C, because the roof covers only grid 1-4 x A-C and never reaches row D. Its x chain is the usual 3.00/2.20/3.00 = 8.20 but with an extra 1.10 eave overhang printed at each end.

z_levels and the two z dimension_chains are read from the two building sections (หน้า10 SECTION A-A, หน้า11 SECTION B-B) — the datum label printed next to '±0000' is a short, slightly smudged Thai phrase transcribed here as 'ระดับดินเดิม' (original/existing ground level) at 2x zoom; the first two glyphs are legible but the reading is not 100%-certain at this scan resolution, flagged as a per-line confidence_flag on that z_levels entry rather than lowering the whole file's score.

Roof levels differ between the west/main ridge line (+8.885, 'ระดับหลังอกไก่เหล็กบนสุด' — top of the steel ridge framing itself, section A-A left side) and the east/south hip ridge tile line (+7.555, 'ระดับหลังอกไก่กระเบื้อง' — top of the ridge roof tile, section A-A right side): this is a real hip-roof geometry difference (two different ridge readings on the same section, not a transcription conflict) — both recorded as separate z_levels entries.

CORRECTED 2026-08-24 (Makham, y-axis dummy rows). The previous version of this file recorded a single dummy row A'=1.60 and dismissed every '✕---value' crosshair tick in the หน้า15/หน้า16 margins as survey/setback annotation. Both conclusions were wrong. Those ticks are genuine dimension-chain points and the chains close exactly on the named grid: หน้า16's left margin prints 1.10 (above A) | 0.80 + 2.20 = 3.00 (A-B) | 1.15 + 1.85 = 3.00 (B-C) | 0.40 (below C) | 2.00 (C-D), and หน้า15's left margin prints 1.60 (above A) | 2.00 + 1.00 = 3.00 (A-B). Verified by pixel measurement on the source PNGs, not by eye: on หน้า16 rows A/B/C/D sit at y=768/1085/1404/1618 px (105.7-107.0 px/m, consistent) and the A-B tick sits at y=853 = A+0.80 exactly.

The three y-axis dummy rows that follow from the corrected chains, each confirmed against a real beam (beam-endpoint rule §4), scanned top-to-bottom for prime ordering: (1) A' = -1.10, the north stair/entrance projection's outer beam — B1(+3.65) on หน้า16, B1(+0.40) on หน้า15; printed as '1.10' in หน้า16's left margin AND in หน้า15's right margin, two independent sheets. Negative pos_m because it sits above the origin row A (§ Dummy grid, origin rule); label 'A'' given directly by Makham. (2) A'' = 0.80, the same projection's inner/south beam — B1(+3.65) on หน้า16 (beam faces measured at y=1189-1191 and y=1206-1208 px, tick on the south face), also printed as '0.80' in หน้า15's right margin. (3) A''' = 2.00, the west appendage's internal split beam B1(+0.35) on หน้า15 (beam faces at y=994 and y=1015 px, tick on the south face) — this is the beam previously mis-assigned to A'=1.60.

The '1.60' still printed above row A in หน้า15's left margin is kept in unassigned_dimensions, not as a grid line: it is 0.50 further out than the A' beam row (1.10) and matches architecture หน้า03's '500+1100=1600' sub-chain, i.e. it dimensions the dashed carport/roof outline edge, which carries no beam and no columns — the §4 'do NOT invent a dummy for a slab-only edge' case.

Dummy rows B' = 3.55 and B'' = 4.15, both added 2026-08-24 on Makham's direct instruction and both confirmed against a real beam. B'' = 4.15 comes from หน้า16's left-margin chain (1.15 + 1.85 = 3.00 across B-C); its tick at y=1207 px lands on the south face of the small RB1'(+3.65) stub beside the S1 +3.75 stair landing between grids 2-3 (beam faces y=1189-1191 / 1206-1208). That RB1' was the one beam on หน้า16 with no line to sit on — recorded as '~B2', confidence 0.5, flagged approximate; it now resolves exactly to B''2. B' = 3.55 comes from หน้า15's left-margin 0.55 tick below row B (y=1180 px); its line lands on the south face of a horizontal beam spanning grids 2-3 whose printed mark reads B2(+0.40) at 9x zoom (beam faces y=1154-1158 / 1174-1180). NOTE the prime order: B'(3.55) is above B''(4.15), per the top-to-bottom scan rule. 4.15 was briefly named B' earlier the same day and was renamed to B'' when 3.55 was confirmed — the same reordering houses 1-2 had to do for 3'/3'' (สิ่งที่ต้องแก้ items 1-2).

The B'(3.55) beam is genuinely offset from row B, and this is a real floor-to-floor difference, not a reading error: on หน้า15 (floor 1) that beam sits 0.31-0.55 m BELOW row B, while its floor-2 counterpart on หน้า16 is centred on row B itself (faces y=1073-1075 / 1094-1096, row B at y=1085). Row B on หน้า15 carries only the bare dash-dot grid line in both the grid1-2 and grid2-3 bays (coverage 0.797 / 0.781, single line, no beam face pair) — only the grid3-4 bay has a beam actually on row B.

STILL OPEN after the 2026-08-24 correction — tick rows in the same margin chains NOT promoted to dummy grid lines, because no beam was found on them: C-0.40 = 5.60 and D-0.40 = 7.60 and D+0.60 = 8.60 (หน้า15), C+0.40 = 6.40 (หน้า16 left margin — no horizontal beam line found at that y between grids 3-4 on a pixel scan) and C+0.50 = 6.50 (หน้า16 right margin, 0.10 off the left margin's own tick on the same sheet). Also not yet transcribed anywhere in this file: หน้า16's bottom-margin x sub-ticks (1.10/1.10/0.40/0.20 and 0.20/0.40).

No soil boring log, no separate plan_column sheet, and no door/window schedule TABLE (หน้า13 is architectural door/window DETAIL elevations with dimensions, not a schedule list) were found in this 22-page set — see _scope.json.
